_gemini_flash_note: gemini_flash MUST track whatever the `flash` tier resolves to in agy-delegate.sh's model_for_tier(), because agy-cost-compare.sh picks this key by tier NAME, not by model. Today that is Gemini 3.8 Flash (High), so gemini_flash mirrors gemini_flash_38 (3.8, 3.7 and 3.6 carry identical list prices). IMPORTANT: 3.6, 3.7 and 3.8 are on PROMOTIONAL pricing that ends 2026-12-31 — on 2027-01-01 input goes 0.75 -> 1.50, output 3.75 -> 7.50 and cached_in 0.075 -> 0.15. Leaving these as-is after that date understates the Gemini side by half. The _post_2026 entries carry the standard rates; copy them over then. Verified 2026-09-03 against ai.google.dev/gemini-api/docs/pricing and Google Cloud's Agent Platform pricing page (cloud.google.com/gemini-enterprise-agent-platform/generative-ai/pricing; non-global endpoints are +10%).
_comment: Per-1M-token USD on Vertex AI (global endpoints; regional/multi-region carry a ~10% premium). Re-verified 2026-10-19 against cloud.google.com/vertex-ai/generative-ai/pricing and platform.claude.com/docs/en/about-claude/pricing for the models agy 1.4.x actually lists: Claude Opus 5.5 (4/20), Claude Sonnet 5.5 (2/10), Gemini 3.1 Pro (2/12, cached 0.20), Gemini 4 Argon (2/10 intro, 4/20 standard). VERIFY against your own invoice before quoting: the Argon introductory rate did not appear on at least one pay-as-you-go project's billing export (it was billed 4/20 on 2026-10-09), and Google's promo end dates move.
_cache_note: cache_write_mult / cache_read_mult apply to the CLAUDE deck only (Opus 5.5 / Sonnet 5.5: 5-minute cache write = 1.25x input, cache read = 0.05x input — the Opus 4.x generation read at 0.10x). Gemini prices cached input at a flat rate (cached_in) and bills context-cache STORAGE by time, which agy does not report — so any Gemini-side figure you compute here is a LOWER BOUND.
_gemini_argon_note: Gemini 4 Argon (the `pro` tier default since 0.29.0; consumer Google AI plans list it instead of 3.1 Pro as reported in #104 (not measured here), and enterprise plans, which were measured on agy 1.4.2, list it alongside `Gemini 3.1 Pro`). Introductory rate through 2026-11-30; `_post_2026_12` carries the standard rate that applies from 2026-12-01 — copy it over then. agy-cost-compare.sh prices `--tier pro` from `gemini_argon` when the resolved pro model is Argon and from `gemini_pro` otherwise.
